Table "public"."applicants" {
  "applicant_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "first_name" TEXT
  "last_name" TEXT
  "email" TEXT
  "phone" TEXT
  "date_of_birth" TEXT
  "address" TEXT
  "city" TEXT
  "state" TEXT
  "zip" TEXT
  "income" REAL
  "marital_status" TEXT
  "education_level" TEXT
  "employment_status" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."application_reviews" {
  "review_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "application_id" INTEGER
  "officer_id" INTEGER
  "review_date" TEXT
  "comments" TEXT
  "rating" REAL
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."applications" {
  "application_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "applicant_id" INTEGER
  "application_date" TEXT
  "loan_amount" REAL
  "loan_purpose" TEXT
  "status" TEXT
  "loan_term" INTEGER
  "interest_rate" REAL
  "fee_amount" REAL
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."approval_criteria" {
  "criteria_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "criteria_name" TEXT
  "criteria_description" TEXT
  "min_credit_score" INTEGER
  "max_debt_to_income" REAL
  "min_income" REAL
  "min_employment_duration" REAL
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."audit_logs" {
  "audit_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "action" TEXT
  "action_date" TEXT
  "action_description" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."branches" {
  "branch_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "branch_name" TEXT
  "branch_location" TEXT
  "contact_number" TEXT
  "fax_number" TEXT
  "email" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."credit_scores" {
  "score_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "applicant_id" INTEGER
  "score" INTEGER
  "score_date" TEXT
  "credit_agency" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."defaults" {
  "default_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "applicant_id" INTEGER
  "loan_id" INTEGER
  "default_date" TEXT
  "default_amount" REAL
  "default_reason" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."employment_history" {
  "employment_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "applicant_id" INTEGER
  "company_name" TEXT
  "position" TEXT
  "years_employed" REAL
  "monthly_income" REAL
  "job_type" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."loan_approvals" {
  "approval_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "application_id" INTEGER
  "officer_id" INTEGER
  "approval_date" TEXT
  "approved_amount" REAL
  "approval_comments" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."loan_officers" {
  "officer_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "first_name" TEXT
  "last_name" TEXT
  "email" TEXT
  "phone" TEXT
  "branch_id" INTEGER
  "job_title" TEXT
  "years_of_experience" REAL
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."loan_purposes" {
  "purpose_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "purpose_name" TEXT
  "purpose_description" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."loan_terms" {
  "term_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "term_duration" INTEGER
  "interest_rate" REAL
  "fee_amount" REAL
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."rejections" {
  "rejection_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "application_id" INTEGER
  "rejection_date" TEXT
  "reason" TEXT
  "rejection_comments" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."reports" {
  "report_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "report_name" TEXT
  "report_type" TEXT
  "report_date" TEXT
  "report_data" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."users" {
  "user_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "username" TEXT
  "password" TEXT
  "role" TEXT
  "branch_id" INTEGER
  "first_name" TEXT
  "last_name" TEXT
  "email" TEXT
  "phone" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Ref: "public"."application_reviews"."application_id" > "public"."applications"."application_id"
Ref: "public"."application_reviews"."officer_id" > "public"."loan_officers"."officer_id"
Ref: "public"."applications"."applicant_id" > "public"."applicants"."applicant_id"
Ref: "public"."audit_logs"."user_id" > "public"."users"."user_id"
Ref: "public"."credit_scores"."applicant_id" > "public"."applicants"."applicant_id"
Ref: "public"."defaults"."applicant_id" > "public"."applicants"."applicant_id"
Ref: "public"."employment_history"."applicant_id" > "public"."applicants"."applicant_id"
Ref: "public"."loan_approvals"."officer_id" > "public"."loan_officers"."officer_id"
Ref: "public"."loan_approvals"."application_id" > "public"."applications"."application_id"
Ref: "public"."loan_officers"."branch_id" > "public"."branches"."branch_id"
Ref: "public"."rejections"."application_id" > "public"."applications"."application_id"
